Safety audits on hydroelectric power projects in Kishtwar, J and K.
details:
(a) the number of workers fatalities and serious injuries recorded at CVPPL/NHPC hydroelectric Power projects sites going on in district Kishtwar during the last five years, project-wise detail along with the compensations paid to victim's families; and
(b) weather statutory safety audits of tunnels and dam sites are conducted periodically by an independent authority and the details and findings of the last such audits?

records.title: Impact of hydropower projects in Kishtwar J and K on houses/structures
details:
(a) the number of houses/structures in Kishtwar district that have developed cracks or been rendered unsafe due to blasting, tunnelling and muck disposal for CVPPL/NHPC hydro projects, village-wise, the compensation assessed and actually disbursed to affected families; and
(b) weather environmental clearance conditions on muck disposal and blasting norms have been complied with and independently audited and weather forest land was diverted or damaged without requisite clearance?

Setting up of Agriculture University in Chenab Region, Jammu and Kashmir
details:
(a) whether Government has examined the need for a dedicated Agriculture University or a regional Campus in the Chenab region of Jammu and Kashmir (J&K), given its unique agro-climatic conditions, dependency on horticulture, pastoral farming and rain-fed agriculture; and
(b) if so, whether Government proposes to establish an Agriculture University focused on hill agriculture, climate-resilient farming, research and farmer training, in Kishtwar, Doda or Ramban districts, if so, the details of proposed funding, implementation roadmap and timelines thereof?

(b) the total number of deadlines transgressed, the present stage of all unfinished segments, the newly stipulated completion timelines, the environmental impact assessments undertaken, and the geotechnical mitigation measures adopted to address landslides and ecological vulnerabilities; and
